title: Shush, Amedi, Barzan & Korek Mountain
full_text:
Morning in Shush Village, enjoy a homemade breakfast and a walk around the village’s ancient sites.
Head to the unique town of Amedi, and explore its historical significance.
Drive through Barzan, and visit the Barzani memorial.
Visit Shanidar Cave, where the earliest evidence of Neanderthals were found.
Continue to Korek Mountain Resort for an overnight stay.
Take a cable car ride up Korek Mountain, while enjoying the stunning views of the surrounding landscapes.
Spend the evening relaxing in the resort.
